title: R
body:
This was one of the best apps that I have tried for tracking my habits. Its design was prefect and simple and although the features are not as much as other apps. It still has all the tools to keep you going. And keep you going it did to me. However my biggest disappointment was the fact that this needs a subscription. That was the worst thing ever. I mean other apps might require subscriptions but are still usable but this app becomes useless once you got to your three habits. 
I know that the subscription might be cheap and that the developer need money to live but also for me personally I can’t buy anything online. It is a special case in my country where you can’t just buy anything online wether it is apple store or amazon. I don’t mind having a subscription but this could be done on other features where the app will still be usable while having other features locked behind a buy wall
